about: Field guides shown on /research/guides/. Only guides listed here are built, and a guide is listed only after the site owner has read and approved it (approved = date). Bodies come from import_guide.py.

guides.title: Field guide: Agent memory
guides.summary: What to store, how to retrieve it, and when memory helps or hurts an agent, from a full read of the papers.

guides.title: Field guide: Agent self-improvement
guides.summary: How agents that rewrite their own prompts, skills or harness actually improve, and the gates that keep them honest.

guides.title: Field guide: Agent evals
guides.summary: When to trust an agent eval: noise floors, matched baselines, checked graders, and tests the agent cannot reach.

guides.title: Field guide: Agent verification
guides.summary: Accepting agent-written work on evidence the agent could not shape: independent oracles, real runs, per-defect grading.

guides.title: Field guide: Agent security
guides.summary: Controls on what an agent can reach and do: sandboxes, credentials, injection testing, model supply chain and incident lessons.

guides.title: Field guide: Multi-agent and harness design
guides.summary: When to use one agent or many, how to coordinate them, and how to design the harness: loops, tools, skills, sandboxes, state, budgets and evaluation.
